cohort_total_n_excerpt: Concentrations of isoflavones and counts of Slackia sp. strain NATTS in feces were measured from 44 patients with prostate cancer and 28 hospital controls.
reason: The abstract evaluates general prostate cancer case-control status and does not analyze an aggressive, advanced, high-grade, metastatic, or lethal incident endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Serum concentrations of genistein, daidzein, glycitein, and equol were not significantly associated with risk of prostate cancer.
estimate_classifications.reason: The genistein association concerns general prostate cancer risk. No aggressive endpoint is described, and the abstract supplies no OR with both confidence limits for genistein.
